## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to. A condition on a rule's answer names the value as the `.rule` writes it (`low`) in the `.gate`, and as the string Cedar is given (`"low"`) in the Cedar.

### permit `low_x_reads`

A person whose x is low reads

- On `read_doc`, it allows 2 combinations; no other permit allows 1 of them.

`tests/walk/together/sums.gate`

```gate
permit low_x_reads
  description "A person whose x is low reads"
  principal is User
  action read_doc
  when x is low
```

`cedar/sums.cedar`

```cedar
@id("sums/low_x_reads")
@doc("A person whose x is low reads")
permit (
  principal is Docs::User,
  action == Docs::Action::"read_doc",
  resource is Docs::Doc
)
when { context.x == "low" };
```

### permit `high_y_reads`

A person whose y is high reads

- On `read_doc`, it allows 2 combinations; no other permit allows 1 of them.

`tests/walk/together/sums.gate`

```gate
permit high_y_reads

```

`cedar/sums.cedar`

```cedar
@id("sums/high_y_reads")
@doc("A person whose y is high reads")
permit (
  principal is Docs::User,
  action == Docs::Action::"read_doc",
  resource is Docs::Doc
)
when { context.y == "high" };
```

## Computed values

What an action computes and gives Cedar in its context. The generated code computes each one from the service's own data, the operation's arguments and the server's clock, and never takes it from the caller. The pages of the rules and the dates are the pages for people that rulec and koyomi draw, as they draw them.

## Expectations, separations and roles

### Expectations

- `a_low_x_never_has_a_high_y` (expects deny, on `read_doc`): A sum of 100 or less is not over 150, so nobody has a low x and a high y. Whether it holds is undecided.

### Roles

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `read_doc` |

| `User` | sometimes |
